_description: Rise FC schema lint rules. Defines blocked modules, held fields, allowed future homepage modules, and JSON-LD safety rules for use in QA and validation steps. This is a rule definition only — not a validator script, not a real run artifact.

allowedModules.description: Schema @type values permitted for the first-page lane (homepage, route /).
allowedModules.note: ListItem is permitted only as a child of BreadcrumbList.

blockedModules.description: Schema @type values that are blocked for the first-page lane. Any draft or implementation containing these must be rejected.

heldFieldCategories.description: Field categories that are held and must not appear in any schema draft or implementation unless explicitly released by owner approval.

categories.note: Description derived from confirmed factual copy (not tagline or mission line) may be released with owner approval.
Coordinates are blocked via GeoCoordinates blocked module policy.
Address/PostalAddress is blocked via Place blocked module policy.
Any schema field value derived from a testimonial is blocked regardless of @type.
Bilingual or multi-language alternate schema is blocked.

jsonLdSafetyRules.description: JSON-LD structural safety rules that every schema draft and implementation must satisfy.

rules.description: @context must be exactly the string 'https://schema.org'. Not 'http://schema.org'. Not a schema.org array. Not a custom context.
rules.failCondition: @context is missing, is 'http://schema.org', or is any value other than 'https://schema.org'

rules.description: When multiple @type nodes are used, @graph must be present and must be an array.
rules.failCondition: Multiple nodes present without @graph, or @graph is not an array

rules.description: All URL values in the schema must use https:// not http://.
rules.failCondition: Any URL value begins with http://

rules.description: No @type node may contain duplicate property names.
rules.failCondition: Any node contains the same property key more than once

rules.description: All @type values must be valid schema.org types in the current vocabulary.
rules.failCondition: Any @type value is not a recognized schema.org type

rules.description: All property names used within a node must be valid schema.org properties for the node's @type.
rules.failCondition: Any property is not a recognized schema.org property for the given @type

rules.description: No blocked @type value may appear anywhere in the schema graph.
rules.failCondition: Any node @type is in the blockedModules list

rules.description: No held field property may appear in the schema graph.
rules.failCondition: Any property in heldFieldCategories appears in any node

rules.description: Every emitted field value must trace to a confirmed Phase 0 source reference or confirmed page evidence. No invented, inferred, or speculative values.
rules.failCondition: Any field value cannot be traced to an evidence map entry with PHASE_0_CONFIRMED or PAGE_EVIDENCE_CONFIRMED status

rules.description: All draft schema output must be marked as NON_PRODUCTION until explicit human approval is granted.
rules.failCondition: Draft is missing NON_PRODUCTION marker before human approval is documented
